The '''Holt family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from [[Aquilaris Minor]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. At least one of their members [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Notable members included the [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Mercia Holt]] and her husband [[skin diver]] [[Aron Holt]], who were both involved in a [[University of Sanbra]] research project on the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] from the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Their children included their eldest daughter Kerra and an [[Kerra Holt's sibling|unidentified sibling]] who was taken from Mercia shortly after giving birth while under [[Odionate]] captivity at an unknown time after [[1042 BBY]].

The family was separated following the [[Massacre of Aquilaris|invasion]] of Aquilaris Minor in 1042 BBY by the [[Chagras Hegemony]]. The Holt couple were conscripted into an Odionate project known as [[Project Pandemonium]] to recover the Helm. They perished on [[Skarpos]], where they blew themselves up in an attempt to deny the Sith access to the Helm. Their daughter Kerra became a full-fledged Jedi Knight under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. She became involved in several campaigns against the Sith warlords of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]].
